comment: Pinned inputs of the CPU target. `portforge-cpu setup sources` checks these out under <workdir>/src. An entry with `worktree_of` is a second checkout of that repo at another revision.

xnnpack.role: current upstream: scalar oracle, Neon / SSE / AVX / hand-written RVV kernels, tests and benchmarks

xnnpack-saltyrn.role: the XNNPACK revision SALTyRN pins (benchmark/XNNPACK submodule); its kernels and params match this tree

saltyrn.role: Neon sources (kernels/source) and the bounded Neon-vs-RVV verifier; baked into the host image

autocomp.role: SALTyRN's optimizer; backend/saturn and backend/xnnpack hold its FireSim timing harnesses (reference only)

dav1d.role: AV1 decoder: per-ISA hand-written asm kernels + C reference; checkasm is the correctness/benchmark harness (first non-XNNPACK target)
